as_told.title: US programs that recruited gifted children as psychics (Stargate, Grill Flame)

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says the US government spent decades quietly finding children across the country who seemed able to affect things with their minds, and ran psychic experiments on them. In different episodes he says the children were found through gifted-children programmes and taken to national laboratories, naming the Atomic Energy Commission, a former US nuclear agency, and Battelle, a research institute, and elsewhere he links it to the psychic research of the physicists Hal Puthoff and Russell Targ. If true, it would mean psychic ability was treated as real enough to study in children for years.
